visualizations.title: 黄金进位 · 两个 Zeckendorf 表示相加时的进位亏量
visualizations.title_en: Golden carry · the carry deficit when two Zeckendorf representations are added
visualizations.summary: 把 v₁、v₂ 的 Zeckendorf 数字串逐位相加，再按 trureturing 的进位顺序一步一步规范化。页面在 ℤ[φ] 中精确算出亏量 c(v₁, v₂) = β(v₁) + β(v₂) − β(v₁ + v₂)：它的 φ 系数为 0，是整数，等于最低两条重复进位规则的带符号计数，并且只取 −1、0、1——这两条结论已由 Lean 内核验证并冻结。热图逐格画出 0 … N 上的 c。
visualizations.summary_en: Add the Zeckendorf digit strings of v₁ and v₂ digit by digit, then normalize one carry at a time in trureturing's order. The page computes the deficit c(v₁, v₂) = β(v₁) + β(v₂) − β(v₁ + v₂) exactly in ℤ[φ]: its φ-coefficient is 0, so it is an integer, the signed count of the two lowest repeated carries, and it only takes the values −1, 0 and 1 — both facts kernel-verified in Lean and frozen. A heat map draws c cell by cell over 0 … N.
